description: Release an npm package end to end: commit pending work, pick the semver bump, write the CHANGELOG (or consume .changeset files manually), publish with the lockfile's package manager (never npm publish in pnpm/bun repos, workspace:^ leaks), tag, push, create the GitHub release, and deploy the website/ folder via its deploy script.
